text:
maria: Quick note — the runtime docs 'sidecar' curl snippet 403s on staging for me.

maria: Steps: 1) spin up staging, 2) curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/sidecar/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'

maria: Response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\n{"error":"shortlink expired"}

oliver: ack. that's probably the shortlink redirect we recently purged.

samar: pinging docs-bot for link-scan — @docs-bot run quick-check on docs/runtime/sidecar.md

docs-bot: scan complete — found 1 dead shortlink (cdn.redwood.ai/snap/old-token) in sidecar.md line 54. Suggested fix: replace with /assets/snaps/sidecar-curl-2025.json

docs-bot: opening PR template at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2942

leo: I can take the PR. Will swap the snippet and update the token note. Any tests to run?

maria: Thanks! No unit tests, but please run the staging curl in the PR preview. If it still 403s, we probably need infra team to rotate the redirect.

oliver: leaving a tiny nit — change "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -> "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" in sample to avoid copy-paste.

leo: noted. I'll include that and tag @infra if the preview shows 403.

maria: Awesome, TY. @leo add me to the PR and I'll give quick LGTM once preview works :eyes:

leo: PR opened and assigned — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2942 :shipit:

samar: adding to weekly docs triage queue in case others hit it tomorrow.

maria: cool. closing the loop here.
